case_definition: Only half of the reported H1 OCF-less-property screen persists
reinvestment_or_macro_stress: working-capital release does not recur; project margin and customer funding weaken

case_definition: Three quarters of the mechanical screen persists after timing and burden leakage
reinvestment_or_macro_stress: maintenance spending and receivable/inventory burden remain explicit
requires recurring conversion without supplier-finance or acquisition support

case_definition: Three quarters of the stronger reported cash screen persists
reinvestment_or_macro_stress: service cost and customer mix compress margin; inventory economics normalize

case_definition: Ninety percent of the mechanical screen persists
reinvestment_or_macro_stress: onsite and digital growth must offset large-account mix and maintenance burden
requires recurring cash after service; leases; taxes; dilution; and reinvestment

case_definition: Only half of H1 OCF-less-company-capex persists
reinvestment_or_macro_stress: unsigned awards and future phases delay; project estimates and acquisition cash disappoint

case_definition: Three quarters persists after acquisition and contract leakage
reinvestment_or_macro_stress: CEC cash return; earn-outs; dilution; retainage; and customer funding remain open
requires signed backlog conversion and stable cost-to-complete estimates

case_definition: Half of OCF less gross rental capex persists
reinvestment_or_macro_stress: utilization; used-equipment recovery; debt cost; and replacement capex weaken

case_definition: Three quarters persists after fleet-cycle leakage
reinvestment_or_macro_stress: gross capex is not maintenance-free; borrowing-base and lifecycle return remain open
requires recurring utilization and used-equipment proceeds without balance-sheet stress
